MemorySafety.Source.accepted_rust_progra.pretty:
∀ (program : PtxvMemorySafety.ptxv_memory_write.memory_safety.Program)
  (certificate : Aeneas.Std.Slice PtxvMemorySafety.ptxv_memory_write.memory_safety.State),

MemorySafetyExecution.Native.Independent.pretty:
∀ (program : MemorySafetyExecution.Native.CoreProgram) (before after : MemorySafetyExecution.Native.CoreState)
  (actor : Aeneas.Std.Usize) (event : PtxvMemorySafety.ptxv_memory_write.memory_safety.Event),
  MemorySafetyExecution.Native.Independent.Canonical before →
    PtxvMemorySafety.ptxv_memory_write.execution_core.execute program before actor =
        Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.core.result.Result.Ok event, after) →
      MemorySafetyExecution.MachineModel.step (MemorySafetyExecution.Native.Independent.programModel program)
            (MemorySafetyExecution.Native.Independent.stateModel before) ↑actor =
          some (MemorySafety.Source.eventModel event, MemorySafetyExecution.Native.Independent.stateModel after) ∧
        MemorySafetyExecution.Native.Independent.Canonical after

∀ (source entry : List Aeneas.Std.U8) (manifest : PtxFrontendProgram.Manifest)
  (parsed : PtxvMemorySafety.strict_memory_frontend_parse.SourceProgram)
  (program : MemorySafetyExecution.Native.CoreProgram),
  PtxFrontendProgram.ConstructionMeaning source entry manifest parsed program →
    ∀ (certificate : Aeneas.Std.Slice PtxvMemorySafety.ptxv_memory_write.input_independent_execution.State),
      PtxvMemorySafety.ptxv_memory_write.input_independent_execution.verify program certificate =
          Aeneas.Std.Result.ok true →
        ∀ (alternate : MemorySafetyExecution.Native.CoreProgram),
          MemorySafetyExecution.Native.MemoryInstance program alternate →
            MemorySafetyExecution.MachineModel.MemorySafeFrom
              (MemorySafetyExecution.Native.Independent.programModel alternate)
              (MemorySafetyExecution.Native.Independent.stateModel alternate.initial)

MemorySafetyExecution.Source.source_chec.pretty:
∀ {F : Type u_1}
  (producerInterface :
    Aeneas.Std.core.ops.function.FnOnce F (PtxvMemorySafety.ptxv_memory_write.execution_core.Program × Aeneas.Std.Usize)
      PtxvMemorySafety.strict_memory_source.Candidate)
  (source entry : Aeneas.Std.Slice Aeneas.Std.U8) (manifest : PtxvMemorySafety.ptxv_case.Manifest)
  (cap : Aeneas.Std.Usize) (producer : F) (report : PtxvMemorySafety.strict_memory_source.Report),
  PtxvMemorySafety.strict_memory_source.check producerInterface source entry manifest cap producer =
      Aeneas.Std.Result.ok report →
    report.is_safe = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok true → MemorySafetyExecution.SourceMemorySafe (↑source) (↑entry) manifest

∀ {F : Type u_1}
  (producerInterface :
    Aeneas.Std.core.ops.function.FnOnce F (PtxvMemorySafety.ptxv_memory_write.execution_core.Program × Aeneas.Std.Usize)
      PtxvMemorySafety.strict_memory_source.Candidate)
  (source entry : Aeneas.Std.Slice Aeneas.Std.U8) (manifest : PtxvMemorySafety.ptxv_case.Manifest)
  (cap : Aeneas.Std.Usize) (producer : F) (report : PtxvMemorySafety.strict_memory_source.Report),
  PtxvMemorySafety.strict_memory_source.check producerInterface source entry manifest cap producer =
      Aeneas.Std.Result.ok report →
    report.is_safe = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok true →
      ∃ program,
        PtxFrontendProgram.SourceProgram (↑source) (↑entry) manifest program ∧
          ∀ (alternate : MemorySafetyExecution.Native.CoreProgram),
            MemorySafetyExecution.Native.MemoryInstance program alternate →
              ∀ (state : MemorySafetyExecution.MachineModel.State),
                MemorySafetyExecution.MachineModel.Reachable
                    (MemorySafetyExecution.Native.Independent.programModel alternate)
                    (MemorySafetyExecution.Native.Independent.stateModel alternate.initial) state →
                  ∀ (actor : ℕ) (thread : MemorySafetyExecution.MachineModel.Thread),
                    state.threads[actor]? = some thread →
                      thread.running = true →
                        ∃ instruction action,
                          (MemorySafetyExecution.Native.Independent.programModel alternate).code[thread.pc]? =
                              some instruction ∧
                            ValueFlow.evaluate thread.registers thread.ids instruction = some action ∧
                              MemorySafetyExecution.MachineModel.ActionSafe
                                (MemorySafetyExecution.Native.Independent.programModel alternate) state action

∀ {F : Type u_1}
  (producerInterface :
    Aeneas.Std.core.ops.function.FnOnce F (PtxvMemorySafety.ptxv_memory_write.execution_core.Program × Aeneas.Std.Usize)
      PtxvMemorySafety.strict_memory_source.Candidate)
  (source entry : Aeneas.Std.Slice Aeneas.Std.U8) (manifest : PtxvMemorySafety.ptxv_case.Manifest)
  (cap : Aeneas.Std.Usize) (producer : F) (report : PtxvMemorySafety.strict_memory_source.Report),
  PtxvMemorySafety.strict_memory_source.check producerInterface source entry manifest cap producer =
      Aeneas.Std.Result.ok report →
    report.status_name = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.toStr "safe" ⋯) →
      ∀ (program : MemorySafetyExecution.Native.CoreProgram),
        PtxFrontendProgram.SourceProgram (↑source) (↑entry) manifest program →
          ∀ (alternate : MemorySafetyExecution.Native.CoreProgram),
            MemorySafetyExecution.Native.MemoryInstance program alternate →
              ∀ (states : ℕ → MemorySafetyExecution.MachineModel.State) (events : ℕ → MemorySafety.Event),
                MemorySafetyExecution.MachineModel.Execution
                    (MemorySafetyExecution.Native.Independent.programModel alternate)
                    (MemorySafetyExecution.Native.Independent.stateModel alternate.initial) states events →
                  ∀ (first second : ℕ),
                    first < second →
                      ∀ (before after : MemorySafety.AccessRecord),
                        before ∈ MemorySafetyExecution.readWriteRecords (events first) →
                          after ∈ MemorySafetyExecution.readWriteRecords (events second) →
                            ¬MemorySafety.Conflict before after

∀ {F : Type u_1}
  (producerInterface :
    Aeneas.Std.core.ops.function.FnOnce F (PtxvMemorySafety.ptxv_memory_write.execution_core.Program × Aeneas.Std.Usize)
      PtxvMemorySafety.strict_memory_source.Candidate)
  (source entry : Aeneas.Std.Slice Aeneas.Std.U8) (manifest : PtxvMemorySafety.ptxv_case.Manifest)
  (cap : Aeneas.Std.Usize) (producer : F) (report : PtxvMemorySafety.strict_memory_source.Report),
  PtxvMemorySafety.strict_memory_source.check producerInterface source entry manifest cap producer =
      Aeneas.Std.Result.ok report →
    report.status_name = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.toStr "safe" ⋯) →
      MemorySafetyExecution.SourceMemorySafe (↑source) (↑entry) manifest ∧
        ∀ (program : PtxFrontendProgram.Program),
          PtxFrontendProgram.SourceProgram (↑source) (↑entry) manifest program →
            MemorySafetyExecution.Native.FullMachineMemorySafe program ∧
              MemorySafetyExecution.MachineModel.MemorySafeFrom
                  (MemorySafetyExecution.Native.Independent.programModel program)
                  (MemorySafetyExecution.Native.Independent.stateModel program.initial) ∧
                ∀ (alternate : MemorySafetyExecution.Native.CoreProgram),
                  MemorySafetyExecution.Native.MemoryInstance program alternate →
                    MemorySafetyExecution.Native.FullMachineMemorySafe alternate ∧
                      MemorySafetyExecution.MachineModel.MemorySafeFrom
                        (MemorySafetyExecution.Native.Independent.programModel alternate)
                        (MemorySafetyExecution.Native.Independent.stateModel alternate.initial)

∀ {F : Type u_1}
  (producerInterface :
    Aeneas.Std.core.ops.function.FnOnce F (PtxvMemorySafety.ptxv_memory_write.execution_core.Program × Aeneas.Std.Usize)
      PtxvMemorySafety.strict_memory_source.Candidate)
  (source entry : Aeneas.Std.Slice Aeneas.Std.U8) (manifest : PtxvMemorySafety.ptxv_case.Manifest)
  (cap : Aeneas.Std.Usize) (producer : F) (report : PtxvMemorySafety.strict_memory_source.Report),
  PtxvMemorySafety.strict_memory_source.check producerInterface source entry manifest cap producer =
      Aeneas.Std.Result.ok report →
    report.status_name = Aeneas.Std.Result.ok (Aeneas.Std.toStr "safe" ⋯) →
      MemorySafetyExecution.SourceMemorySafe (↑source) (↑entry) manifest
